SCR-45 is in state breaks, with loading; empty, error and no access are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-6423).

started when it consumes `rwb.comms.NoticeDelivered.v1` (DP-09). This story is a secondary slice of the notice-period clock and owns no legacy criterion of RWB-E1-055; both facts keep the one clock, the unique running index and the idempotency key of notice and delivered date, so a second fact is a repeat counted under R-UNI-40. Revisit at the wave 3 refinement of RWB-P3-E5002-APP.
